title: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane steeped in myth where gods influence mortals and the boundary with Nyx is growing thin.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The proverbial land of dreams and home of the gods, visited by mortals who sleep and dream.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker who returned to Theros and, through rituals, ascended to become the god of revels.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Beings born of the gods' starry domain that began appearing in the mortal world.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of slaughter, who sends minotaur hordes against human cities; brother and rival of Iroas.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: Patron of Akros and brother and rival of Mogis.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A mountain fortress city of Theros hit hardest by the minotaur siege.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A major human city of Theros near which Kiora's wave struck.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: One of the three major cities of Theros.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who led an army of heroes to break the siege of Akros and was blamed for Xenagos's ascension.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun and patron of justice, preparing to restore the proper order.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea, whose worship Kiora is being mistaken for.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar who came to Theros seeking immense sea creatures to use against the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's home plane, ravaged by the Eldrazi swarm.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: Theros's native merfolk, who believe Kiora is an avatar of Thassa.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: Mogis's favored race, sent against the human cities.

entities.name: Grand Revel
entities.description: The mad rollick instigated by Xenagos that spills across Theros.

events.summary: Xenagos returns to Theros and performs rituals to become god of revels, blurring the line between Nyx and the mortal world.
events.quote: These rituals had an unanticipated side effect: the blurring of the lines between the realm of the gods and everyday existence.

events.summary: The gods blame each other for the chaos and send Nyxborn creatures against mortals.
events.quote: the gods blamed each other for the chaos and, in their anger, sent ferocious Nyxborn creatures against the mortals.

events.summary: Mogis sends minotaur hordes against human cities, with Akros bearing the brunt.
events.quote: He began sending hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities.

events.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege; the victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god.
events.quote: the victory celebration after the battle became the ultimate ritual to launch Xenagos into Nyx as a god.

events.summary: Elspeth is blamed for Xenagos's ascension and driven into the wilderness, vanishing in disgrace.
events.quote: Elspeth was blamed for his ascension and driven into the wilderness.

events.summary: Human cities begin to recruit the Nyxborn into their armies.
events.quote: The human cities have begun to recruit the Nyxborn into their own armies.

events.summary: The gods realize a mortal has forced his way into the pantheon and fear their nature as creations of the world being revealed.
events.quote: a mortal has launched himself into Nyx and forced his way into the pantheon

events.summary: Heliod begins preparing a way to restore the proper order.
events.quote: He has begun preparing a way to restore the proper order

events.summary: Kiora arrives on Theros and raises a huge wave to call sea beasts, damaging the shore near Meletis.
events.quote: she raised up an enormous wave to call to the ocean beasts.

events.summary: The tritons encounter Kiora riding a conjured leviathan and some believe she is a herald of Thassa.
events.quote: Some tritons believe that Kiora is an avatar or herald of Thassa, god of the sea.
